title: PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
author: Qiushi Sun, Jingyang Gong, Yang Liu, Qiaosheng Chen et al.
description: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents. Recently, proprietary models have pushed far ahead…
summary: Multimodal code intelligence connects the symbolic world of programs with the visual world their execution creates. Interest in this capability is burgeoning, as models are increasingly asked to produce charts, webpages, animations, and semi-structured documents.
takeaways: The same rubric serves as both filter and reward: it curates the supervised corpus, then drives reinforcement learning on visual-coding tasks.
On the model side, we train PrismaCoder-9B and PrismaCoder-35B on this data and release both.
Our analyses further show that the proposed rubric-based pipeline improves multimodal coding performance across model backbones.
